title: Identify a complete independent clause
instructions: Choose the option that forms a complete sentence.

parts.prompt: Which option contains an independent clause that expresses a complete message?

options.text: While the buses waited at the gate.
The volunteers checked each name before boarding.
Because heavy rain delayed the journey.

choice_rationales.A: While makes the clause dependent, so the reader is still waiting for the main event.
choice_rationales.B: The volunteers is the subject, checked is the finite verb, and the clause expresses a complete message.
choice_rationales.C: Because introduces a reason that needs a main clause to complete the message.
choice_rationales.D: This time phrase contains a subject and verb but begins with after and needs a main clause.

parts.hint: Look for an option that has a subject and finite verb and does not begin with a dependent-clause signal.
parts.correct_explanation: “The volunteers checked each name before boarding” has a subject, a finite verb and a complete message.
